title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Out-of-Distribution Detection: A Sorites Paradox
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection methods and the construction of a new benchmark (IS-OOD). While it references the 'Sorites Paradox' and includes a standard section on societal impact, it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
